s: And you don't just watch the show. At Stampede Park, walk up on stage, grab the mic and perform, while the crowd in cowboy hats dances and the lyrics light up the big screen.
n: And here's the best part: you don't have to play alone.
Go online, and dozens of Calgarians can share the same city at the same time, up to forty players at once.
Explore together. Hop in a friend's car and ride along, or fly over the skyline together in a helicopter.
Chat by text, or hold the mic button and talk with voice chat to the players near you.
It's all free, right in your web browser.
q: Take the stage at Stampede Park. Or go online, and explore the city together with other Calgarians.
